paper.title: SPELL: Self-Play Reinforcement Learning for Evolving Long-Context Language Models
paper.central_claim: SPELL is a multi-role self-play RL framework in which one LLM acts as questioner, responder and verifier on raw long documents, with an automated curriculum (history memory of recent solvable QA pairs, Gaussian difficulty reward) and GRPO updates; it improves six long-context benchmarks across 12 models.
